{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Print the required numbers
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline = -999: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')
print(f'After filtering, rows with valid baseline biomarker: {len(df_clean)}')
print(f'After deduplication (keeping highest sample_seq per patient): {len(df_dedup)} patients')
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {df_dedup["biomarker_baseline"].mean()}')"}
